notes: lastupdate.txt is the live file as captured (its size/md5 columns describe the original 99 KB export, not the trimmed fixture). The export zip was built from seven real GDELT 2.0 15-minute export files captured from data.gdeltproject.org (20261107100000, 20261108160000, 20261109140000, 20261109210000, 20261110060000, 20261110120000 and 20261110174500): 460 real rows were selected (all usable protest rows, a place-diverse sample of conflict and cooperation rows, same-article duplicate codings, plus non-matching rows: country-level geocodes, verbal events, low-mention cooperation and retrospective SQLDATEs), concatenated in time order with each row keeping its own DATEADDED, and re-zipped with fflate under the newest file's name so that the real unzip path is exercised. Two privacy trims were applied to every row: the unused Actor1Name/Actor2Name columns were blanked, and SOURCEURL was reduced to the publisher's origin plus a '#gdelt-fixture-<hash>' fragment (article slugs can carry names of individuals); all other columns are unmodified. The malformed variant is a hand-authored 15-row export (zipped the same way) using example.org URLs.
